title: Wait a Minute, WHO ARE YOU?
blurb: Betrayed confusion, delivered at an intensity the situation never came close to deserving. The line comes from a 1989 instructional video about playing the kazoo, of all things, which the internet unearthed and elevated into one of its most enduring artefacts. It works for sudden identity crises of every scale: an unrecognised number texting something familiar, a stranger in the group photograph nobody can place, a friend after a significant glow-up. Wait a minute. The delivery is the entire joke, and it has never once been improved upon.
origin: From the viral 'You on Kazoo' video — the kazoo kid's iconic line.
